name: Amaretto Sour
source:
You're on a date with Lili but things aren't going very smoothly... With the help of the bartender and some flavourful drinks, hopefully this date won't go sour!

[from [url=https://holy-family.itch.io/amaretto-sour]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你正与莉莉约会，可一切似乎不太顺利……希望在调酒师和几杯风味饮品的帮助下，这场约会不会变得酸涩！

[摘自[url=https://holy-family.itch.io/amaretto-sour]itch.io[/url]]
